text:
Alex: Quick sync  need final deliverables for the pricing page experiment: FAQ microcopy, definitive tier labels, calc defaults, and webinar lead routing. Can we lock by EOD?

Rina: Prefer literal tier names that map to behaviors. My suggestion: Flex (pay-as-you-go) / Predict (committed) / Private (isolated infra).

Omar: UX note: default the estimator to "Estimated monthly spend (USD)" with an optional toggle to "Cost per 1k tokens". Show assumptions link w/ tokens/request and requests/day.

Sofia: FAQ bullets draft: 1) "How is usage billed?" -> billed per 1k tokens, link to docs. 2) "Can I self-host?" -> yes via Private. 3) "What SLAs?" -> list per-tier SLOs. 4) "Change plan mid-cycle?" -> prorated upgrades. 5) "How long do logs persist?" -> default retention & options. 6) "Discounts?" -> contact accounts. I'll paste trimmed copy later.

Cal: For webinar gating: capture field `calc_monthly_est` on sign-up. Rule: if calc_monthly_est >= 1200 AND email_domain NOT IN (gmail,yahoo,hotmail) -> tag as "pricing_hot" and route to AE pool. Otherwise -> nurture cadence.

Alex: Good. Also propose an experiment: Variant X shows headline CTA "Estimate monthly spend" as primary, Variant Y shows "Cost per 1k tokens" primary. We'll track signup->demo funnel.

Rina: Microcopy change: replace "Estimated monthly" label with "Estimated monthly spend (USD)" and add small "based on your inputs" copy.

Omar: Dev needs: expose flags `estimator_primary_metric` and `pricing_label_set`. QA will need test accounts for both.

MarketingBot: Feature flags created: estimator_primary_metric, pricing_label_set.

Sofia: Benchmark card idea: show one sample workload (support chat, 3k tokens/day) with expected monthly cost and median p95 latency per tier. Use example prices: Flex $0.065/1k, Predict $0.042/1k, Private $0.03/1k.

Cal: SFDC routing: I'll implement flow and share export. Also recommend adding GA event `pricing_calc_submitted` and `webinar_signup_pricing` for attribution.

Alex: Timeline: copy freeze by tomorrow 11am, design mock Wed, front-end flags Wed/Thu, QA Fri. Webinar invite and launch post go live the following Mon.

Rina: I'll post 3 headline variants + final tier microcopy by 3pm.

Omar: I'll wire the toggle + assumptions link and post a tiny code snippet for QA to follow: `fetch('/api/estimate', {body: JSON.stringify({tokens_per_request, requests_per_day, price_per_1k})})`

Sofia: I'll finalize FAQ bullets, keeping them short and action-oriented.

Cal: Routing flow will be staged today. If anyone disagrees with the 1200 threshold speak now.

Alex: Looks good. If no objections, we'll proceed with these rules. Ping me if blockers. :rocket:
